regime_context: The market faces a stagflationary split: hot May PCE sharpened the Fed's hawkish stance under Warsh, while the Iran ceasefire collapse re-primes an upside oil shock just as June payrolls cracked to +57k, now leaving >70% odds of a September hike. The consensus narrative treats the Fed and Treasury as fully coordinated yield suppressors, but revealed preference shows the Fed is inflation-mandate first and the administration wants lower real yields without the optics of near-term cuts—so the front end stays structurally bid while easing remains inflation-gated. The weakest-consensus point is the 'coordinated regime' label: it is better read as aligned incentives with sequenced optionality, not an explicit pact.
regime_context_zh: 市场面临滞胀式分裂：偏热的5月PCE强化了Warsh主导下美联储的鹰派立场，而伊朗停火破裂在6月非农仅+57k之际重新点燃油价上行冲击，当前9月加息概率已超过70%。共识叙事把美联储与财政部视为完全协同的收益率压制者，但揭示性偏好显示美联储以通胀目标为先，而行政当局想要更低实际收益率、却不想要近期降息的观感——因此前端结构上仍有买盘，降息仍被通胀数据所约束。共识最薄弱之处在于“协同体制”这一标签：更准确的理解是激励一致、带有先后次序的期权式安排，而非明确协定。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: With >70% odds of a September hike and Warsh holding a hawkish line at Sintra that inflation is 'too high', rising front-end rate expectations pressure duration despite Treasury's bill-heavy issuance keeping short yields anchored. The market remains more dovish than the Fed (gap -14bp), leaving TLT vulnerable to repricing toward the Fed's path even if Treasury suppresses the front end.
theses.thesis_zh: 在9月加息概率超过70%、Warsh在Sintra坚持“通胀过高”的鹰派立场下，前端利率预期上行给久期资产带来压力，尽管财政部偏重短债发行锚定短端收益率。市场仍比美联储更鸽派（利差-14bp），因此即使财政部压制前端，TLT仍易因向美联储路径重定价而承压。
evidence: CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike (50.6% 25bp + 19.6% 50bp) per intel asof 7/13
Sintra 7/1: Warsh declines to signal July, says 'prices are too high'
Fed path gap end-2026: market 3.96 vs dot 4.1, gap -14bp (market more dovish)
May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y, highest since Oct-2023
theses.dissent: Treasury's explicit yield suppression via bill-heavy issuance, buybacks, and dealer-intermediation reform could keep the entire curve anchored low, and a labor-market crack (June +57k payrolls) may yet force a dovish repricing of the hiking path by late Q3—both would cap TLT downside or even flip it positive.
theses.dissent_zh: 财政部通过偏重短债发行、回购和交易商中介改革明确压制收益率，可能使整条曲线保持低水平，而劳动力市场裂缝（6月非农+57k）或迫使市场在第三季末重新定价加息路径——两者都可能限制TLT下行甚至使其转涨。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse on 7/8 and subsequent US strikes re-primed the energy bid that made energy the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026. With Brent spiking toward $80 and Hormuz transit risk live, XLE carries a headline-driven upside skew relative to SPY despite the broader stagflationary macro drag.
theses.thesis_zh: 7月8日伊朗停火破裂及随后美军打击重新点燃了让能源成为2026年一季度ETF资金流入榜首的能源买盘。Brent飙升至80美元附近、霍尔木兹通行风险高悬，XLE相对SPY具有头条驱动的上行偏斜，尽管整体滞胀宏观环境构成拖累。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict
Re-escalation spike now realized, rotation re-primed by ceasefire collapse
Watch signals: Hormuz transit data (Lloyd's List, Rystad), CENTCOM strike cadence
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation or renewed ceasefire would unwind the geopolitical risk premium quickly, and a September Fed hike into a decelerating labor market could crush oil demand expectations—XLE's realized 0.10 hit in the recent track record was fragile and headline-dependent.
theses.dissent_zh: 快速降级或重启停火将迅速消退地缘风险溢价，而9月加息遇上劳动力市场减速可能打压石油需求预期——近期记录中XLE实现0.10的命中是脆弱且依赖头条的。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff regime remains the core industrial-policy lever steering capital toward domestic semiconductor capacity, and the Section 301 replacement at ~12.5% is pending but not yet resolved. The SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection premium; the onshoring bid persists contingent on the Section 301 handoff completing, which keeps SMH structurally supported versus SPY despite macro rate pressure.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税体制仍是引导资本流向国内半导体产能的核心产业政策杠杆，约12.5%的301条款替代方案待定但尚未解决。最高法院的否决并未取消关税保护溢价；只要301条款衔接顺利完成，在岸化买盘持续存在，使SMH相对SPY具有结构性支撑，尽管面临宏观利率压力。
evidence: China theater: Section 122 expiring July 24, Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending
SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind the tariff-protection premium
Rotation theme: Domestic semiconductors / fabs, proxies SMH, SOXX
Recent hit: SMH overweight realized +0.0138 vs SPY (check-by 10/2)
theses.dissent: If the Section 301 handoff of the ~12.5% tariff stalls or the China truce widens into genuine tariff relief, the onshoring premium could compress quickly; plus a September hike with hot PCE raises the discount rate on long-duration semiconductor growth stories, capping SMH's relative upside.
theses.dissent_zh: 若301条款约12.5%关税的衔接停滞，或中国休战扩大为实质性关税减免，在岸化溢价可能迅速压缩；加之9月加息遇上偏热PCE会抬升长久期半导体成长股的折现率，限制SMH的相对上行。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: XOP
theses.thesis: Iran re-escalation disproportionately benefits domestic E&P names via the oil-price spike, and XOP carries higher beta to Brent than diversified XLE. The ceasefire collapse headlines put a direct bid under US producers, and the admin's energy-security stance leaves no near-term supply suppression from the federal side.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗局势再度升级通过油价飙升对国内勘探与生产企业格外有利，XOP对Brent的贝塔高于多元化的XLE。停火破裂的头条直接支撑美国生产商，而行政当局的能源安全立场意味着联邦层面近期不会压制供给。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire collapse 7/8, US strikes 7/8-11, Brent ~$80 intraday
Rotation theme: Energy (oil & gas), proxies XLE, XOP, basis FACT mechanism (headline-fragile)
theses.dissent: XOP is headline-fragile: any ceasefire or verbal de-escalation would unwind the risk premium fast, and if Warsh's hiking bias triggers a growth scare, oil demand repricing hits E&P more than integrated majors, leaving XOP at risk of sharp relative drawdown.
theses.dissent_zh: XOP对头条高度敏感：任何停火或口头降级都会迅速消退风险溢价，而若Warsh的加息倾向引发增长恐慌，石油需求重定价对勘探开采企业的打击大于一体化巨头，XOP面临剧烈相对回撤的风险。

falsifier.text: XOP lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: SHV
theses.thesis: Treasury's front-end yield suppression (bill-heavy issuance, buybacks, dealer reform, stablecoin T-bill demand) plus Bessent's 'strong dollar while cutting' FX bridge keep front-end yields anchored even as the Fed hikes. SHV captures this structurally lower short-rate path relative to SPY with minimal duration risk while the hiking cycle remains live.
theses.thesis_zh: 财政部的前端收益率压制（偏重短债发行、回购、交易商改革、稳定币对短债的需求）加上Bessent“维持强势美元同时降息”的汇率桥梁，在美联储加息的同时锚定前端收益率。SHV在加息周期尚未结束之际，以极低久期风险捕获这一结构性偏低的短端利率路径，相对SPY占优。
evidence: Dollar/debt theater: front-end Treasuries + low-real-yield regime, stablecoin issuers a structural T-bill bid
Bessent 6/24 'strong dollar while cutting' as FX bridge
Fed keeps reinvesting MBS runoff into T-bills through 2026 (open prediction)
Rotation theme: Front-end Treasuries, proxies BIL, SHV
theses.dissent: If the front end reprices to a genuine multi-hike Fed path unbuffered by Treasury interventions, SHV's yield would rise faster than expected but its price would lag SPY's equity upside in a reflationary blow-off; and if easing begins, SHV's relative carry advantage evaporates as risk assets rally.
theses.dissent_zh: 若前端在没有财政部干预缓冲的情况下向真正的多次加息路径重定价，SHV的收益率上升会快于预期，但其价格将在再通胀爆发式行情中落后于SPY的股票上行；而若降息开启，SHV的相对票息优势将随风险资产反弹而消失。

falsifier.text: SHV lags SPY by 1% before the check-by date
